rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it introduces some uncertainty about expansion/hatching despite the provided 3AA expanded-blastocyst grade and gives only moderate specificity on ICM/TE.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, AMH, ovarian response, male factor, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is generally logical and well structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the case data; minor tension exists between questioning morphology early and later strongly endorsing the 3AA assessment.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner grading interpretation, including single embryo transfer and protocol review, though some lifestyle comments are more general than guideline-driven and probability estimates are somewhat clinic-dependent.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and stimulation review, though it stops short of highly specific protocol-level decision pathways.
